---
title: "Experimental Design"
---

Notes on designing and analysing experiments. Start with the question and
design, then plan the sample and choose an analysis that respects the design.

## Learning order

1. [Design Principles](design-principles.qmd) — causal questions, units, controls, and replication.
2. [Randomisation and Blocking](randomisation-blocking.qmd) — fair allocation and precision.
3. [Power and Sample Size](power-sample-size.qmd) — detectable effects and uncertainty.
4. [Analysis of Designed Experiments](analysis-designed-experiments.qmd) — contrasts, ANOVA, regression, and diagnostics.

## Further resources

- [NIST Engineering Statistics Handbook](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/) — design and analysis reference.
- [OpenStax Introductory Statistics](https://openstax.org/details/books/introductory-statistics-2e) — accessible statistical foundations.
